hybrid.top: dynamic owner array of min(R-1,W+1), existing job mutex
hybrid.bottom: persistent worker slot if R-1>=W; otherwise direct row index
hybrid.serial: existing W=1 serial path retained as in dual_token; no claim that its legacy allocation reaches row-MT bound

semantics.hash: SHA256 visible bytes per plane/frame plus aggregate; normalized per-frame/row/plane copy-site sequence hash; global worker interleaving separately retained but not required identical
semantics.same_instance_sequence: for every depth/chroma, concatenate R=3,67,3,131,1 enabled; R=17 disabled; R=17 enabled; same codec instance, requested W=1,2,8,16 and row_mt=0,1

safety.conformance: same official upstream vectors and separate two MKV payload routes used previously, independent new hybrid execution
safety.leaks: macOS leaks --atExit on new hybrid Release audit binary, including clean and fault cases; unsupported is not PASS
safety.skipped_unsupported: explicit, never PASS; missing required supported coverage prevents PROCEED

allocation.metric: actual requested and backing-block malloc_size bytes from dedicated allocation-only builds; separated pixel, owner/index, worker structure, allocator padding; not RSS/SRAM/area/power/energy

timing.independent_run_unit: one fresh-process 3-variant block; all bootstrap indices resample whole blocks within a cell
timing.within_block_order: six permutations, each twice per cell, prospectively randomized seed 310031
timing.between_blocks: 2-second quiet interval; cells interleaved by blocked schedule; no other task build/test launched during timing
timing.warmups: one decode per variant/cell, retained but excluded prospectively
timing.primary: median of within-block hybrid/type_fix decode-time ratios; decode API calls and flush, preload/hash excluded
timing.bootstrap: 50000 whole-block resamples, seeded 311000+cell, percentile 95% CI of median
timing.pass: every local hybrid/type_fix upper CI<=1.02; no missing blocks, matching frames/hash, measured CDEF activity
timing.explicit_regression: lower CI>1.02; otherwise unestablished noninferiority is KEEP, not PASS
timing.scope: only frozen local workload/host; no universal <=2% or speedup claim; technical blocks are not independent content samples; no pooling old token CI

real_content.encode: fixed official raw input IDs/hashes; first 10 frames; cq 0(lossless),24,56; same encoder settings and all contents retained
real_content.activation: actual source-level filtered luma blocks and strengths; cq levels are prospective low/moderate/high operating settings, not guaranteed measured strata; failure to span activity must be recorded as incomplete, no content replacement

paper: only if PROCEED, record new main-implementation/contribution disposition in new H1 package; do not overwrite old paper/results
